label: warehouse-list-price-cost
sql: SELECT u.sku_name,u.usage_unit,CAST(sum(u.usage_quantity) AS STRING) dbus,CAST(min(p.pricing.default) AS STRING) min_usd_per_dbu,CAST(max(p.pricing.default) AS STRING) max_usd_per_dbu,CAST(sum(u.usage_quantity*p.pricing.default) AS STRING) list_usd FROM system.billing.usage u JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name=p.sku_name AND u.cloud=p.cloud AND u.usage_unit=p.usage_unit AND p.currency_code='USD' AND u.usage_start_time>=p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time<p.price_end_time) WHERE u.workspace_id='7405607548213398' AND u.usage_date>=DATE '2026-10-05' AND u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id='2439e1f2e37ac563' GROUP BY u.sku_name,u.usage_unit ORDER BY u.sku_name
